# megooflags_flag (Resource)

A feature flag and its variations. Its targeting per environment is megooflags_flag_environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "megooflags_flag" "new_checkout" {
  project     = megooflags_project.shop.key
  key         = "new-checkout"
  type        = "boolean"
  name        = "New checkout"
  description = "Replaces the old checkout"
  tags        = ["checkout"]
  owner       = "team-shop"
}

resource "megooflags_flag" "theme" {
  project = megooflags_project.shop.key
  key     = "theme"
  type    = "string"
  name    = "Theme"

  variations = [
    { key = "light", name = "Light", value_json = jsonencode("light") },
    { key = "dark", name = "Dark", value_json = jsonencode("dark") },
  ]
  off_variation = "light"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Flag key. Changing it replaces the flag.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `project` (String) Project key. Changing it replaces the flag.
- `type` (String) Value type: boolean, string, number or json. Changing it replaces the flag.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `off_variation` (String) Key of the variation served when the flag is off in an environment.
- `owner` (String) Owner, for example a team or an email address.
- `permanent` (Boolean) A permanent flag is never reported as stale.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags.
- `variations` (Attributes List) Values the flag can serve, matched by key. When omitted the server creates the defaults for the type (true and false for boolean flags). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variations))

<a id="nestedatt--variations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variations`

Required:

- `key` (String) Variation key.
- `value_json` (String) The value as JSON, for example jsonencode(true). Compared as JSON, so 1 and 1.0 are the same.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `name` (String) Display name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is <project>/<flag>.
terraform import megooflags_flag.new_checkout shop/new-checkout
```
